incident_time: Car 44 turned into the corner earlier than usual and therefore impacted the driver of Car 55 in his overtaking attempt. No driver is deemed predominantly to blame for the collision and therefore no further action is taken.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, telemetry and in-car video evidence. Car 55 attempted an overtake on the inside of Car 44 into Turn 17 and both cars made contact at the apex. The Stewards determine that both drivers contributed to the incident as Car 55 did not clearly get in a position to have the right to the racing line according to the Driving Standards Guidelines and at the same
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
